title: Initial Hermes Agent case study and workbench borrowing analysis
summary: Cloned Hermes Agent to D:\hermes-agent, analyzed it as a long-running and memory-first agent workbench, added user and agent case docs, added comparison docs against deer-flow and claude-code, and extracted the most valuable ideas for upgrading the current workbench.
skill_promotions: Promoted Hermes-derived workbench lessons into autonomous-delivery-default and the 4 core Agent research skills
memory_promotions: Promoted stable workbench rule that new information should enter sessions first
Promoted stable autonomous execution preference with phase reporting and evidence tracking
doc_promotions: Created shared development phase report template
Added workbench development report to track implementation phases

promotion_review.decision: This session promoted reusable methods into skills, durable rules into memory, and shared artifacts into docs, so all three promotion paths were explicitly checked and recorded.

followup_actions.action: Continue connecting session workflow to skill and memory feedback checks
followup_actions.notes: The workflow now records promotions, but future sessions still need stronger default checks and automation.
